archetypes.copy: Your desk has no secrets, only shortcuts. No repetitive task survives three rounds with you — by the third, you have automated it.
archetypes.name: Ctrl Key Made Flesh

archetypes.copy: Your commit log is nocturnal: invisible by day, eight pushes at 3am. Do not ask — inspiration only clocks in at night.
archetypes.name: The Midnight Committer

archetypes.copy: Whether the project ships is one thing; the vibe is already there. Anyone stuck can count on you to jump in. You are the invisible lubricant of this team.
archetypes.name: The Team Glue
archetypes.tagline: Not the most tickets — the warmest chat

archetypes.copy: Calm on the surface, everyone assumes you are coasting. Then something breaks, and the one who saves the day is you. Hidden depth, that is the word.
archetypes.name: The Zen Sweeper
archetypes.tagline: Never fights for credit — ends fights

archetypes.copy: You can build it, grind it, host it and pace it. The scariest kind of colleague: there is no weak stat to roast.
archetypes.name: The Hexagon Warrior
archetypes.tagline: Can fill any gap, fears nothing

card.label: YOUR WORK PERSONA
card.note: Pure fun — don't take it seriously

options.text: Open the laptop and fix it now
Note it down. Monday exists for a reason

questions.text: Friday, 8pm. A small bug pops up in production —

options.text: Build a prototype and trial it for a week
Call a meeting and let everyone vote

questions.text: The team needs to pick a new tool —

options.text: Files sorted by project, everything in its place
Chaotic, but I can find anything
Ask questions until it is crystal clear
Ship a first version, then align

questions.text: A vague request lands on your plate —

options.text: Sit with colleagues and chat
Headphones on, recharge alone
Volunteer for the next one
Finally, leaving on time
The one who calls the direction
The one quietly taking notes, catching details

questions.text: In meetings you are more like —

options.text: Excited. Docs, all night
First check if someone already built the wheel

questions.text: Facing a tech you have never touched —

options.text: Reply instantly, help if I can
Read it. No rush

questions.text: Someone @s you in the group chat for help —

options.text: How many hard things I shipped
The team vibes I improved
